'''Volume 1''' is the first volume published {{pkmn|in France}} by Kurokawa compiling chapters from the {{MangaArc|Black & White}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. As the chapters of the ''Black & White'' arc included in this volume had not yet been published in graphic novel format in Japan, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.

==Major events==
{{spoilers}}
* {{adv|Black}} starts his journey to beat the Pokémon League.
* {{adv|Cheren}} and {{adv|Bianca}} set off on their journeys to tell Black about the broken Pokédexes.
* Black meets {{tc|Hiker}} Andy and learns about [[Triple Battle]]s.
* {{adv|Black}} meets {{adv|White}}, the president and manager of the Pokémon talent agency, the [[BW Agency]].
* White forcefully employs Black into the BW Agency.
* Black and White encounter [[Team Plasma]].
* Angered that Team Plasma's [[Ghetsis]] has caused people to release their Pokémon, Black tries to stop them from doing so again.
* Black is attacked by [[N|a young man]] who claims he can hear the voices of Pokémon.
